func (r *Repository) Save(ctx context.Context, payment *domain.Payment) (*domain.Payment, error) {
	ctx, span := tracing.Start(ctx, "database:SavePayment")
	defer span.End()

	span.SetAttributes(
		attribute.Stringer("claim_id", payment.ClaimID),
		attribute.String("external_order_id", payment.OrderID),
	)

	p, err := r.master.SavePayment(ctx, queries.SavePaymentParams{
		ClaimID:         payment.ClaimID,
		OrderID:         payment.OrderID,
		RefundID:        payment.RefundID,
		Status:          queries.PaymentStateEnum(payment.Status),
		PaymentMethodID: payment.PaymentMethodID,
		Client:          int32(payment.Client), //nolint:gosec
		TotalCost:       payment.TotalCost,
		DeliveryCost:    payment.DeliveryCost,
		CourierCost:     payment.CourierCost,
		FinalCost:       payment.FinalCost,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("r.master.SavePayment: %w", err)
	}

	return &domain.Payment{
		ClaimID:         p.ClaimID,
		PaymentID:       p.PaymentID,
		OrderID:         p.OrderID,
		RefundID:        p.RefundID,
		Status:          string(p.Status),
		PaymentMethodID: p.PaymentMethodID,
		Client:          int(p.Client),
		TotalCost:       p.TotalCost,
		DeliveryCost:    p.DeliveryCost,
		CourierCost:     p.CourierCost,
		FinalCost:       p.FinalCost,
		CreatedAt:       p.CreatedAt.Time,
		UpdatedAt:       p.UpdatedAt.Time,
	}, nil
}

func (q *Queries) SavePayment(ctx context.Context, arg SavePaymentParams) (Payment, error) {
	row := q.db.QueryRow(ctx, savePayment,
		arg.ClaimID,
		arg.OrderID,
		arg.RefundID,
		arg.Status,
		arg.PaymentMethodID,
		arg.Client,
		arg.TotalCost,
		arg.DeliveryCost,
		arg.CourierCost,
		arg.FinalCost,
	)
	var i Payment
	err := row.Scan(
		&i.OrderID,
		&i.PaymentMethodID,
		&i.Status,
		&i.CreatedAt,
		&i.UpdatedAt,
		&i.PaymentID,
		&i.ClaimID,
		&i.Client,
		&i.TotalCost,
		&i.DeliveryCost,
		&i.CourierCost,
		&i.RefundID,
		&i.FinalCost,
	)
	return i, err
}

func ToDomain(source servergrpc.TrackingLinkSource) TrackingLinkSource {
	switch source {
	case servergrpc.TrackingLinkSource_OMS:
		return TrackingLinkSourceOMS
	case servergrpc.TrackingLinkSource_POST:
		return TrackingLinkSourcePost
	case servergrpc.TrackingLinkSource_C2C:
		return TrackingLinkSourceC2C
	case servergrpc.TrackingLinkSource_UNSPECIFIED:
		return TrackingLinkSourceUnspecified
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

func mapPgSource(source dto.TrackingLinkSource) queries.TrackingLinkSource {
	switch source {
	case dto.TrackingLinkSourceC2C:
		return queries.TrackingLinkSourceC2c
	case dto.TrackingLinkSourceOMS:
		return queries.TrackingLinkSourceOms
	case dto.TrackingLinkSourcePost:
		return queries.TrackingLinkSourcePost
	case dto.TrackingLinkSourceUnspecified:
		return "unknown"
	default:
		return ""
	}
}
